one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-11-24 to 2026-12-23: no Intel earnings (Q4 reports late January). Scheduled or likely items: the Dec FOMC (Polymarket prices only ~3% for a cut by the January 2027 meeting [src 28], so little macro help), possible 14A/EMIB-T customer announcements (CEO: 'next two quarters' [src 2]) and more detail on the first 18A customer [src 23], the securities suit filed Nov 13 [src 22], NVIDIA's leadership turmoil and stake sale [src 24], and year-end tax-loss selling in a name down ~58% from its June high. The stock rose 16% on 2026-11-23 into $59.66 after a -50% two-month fall; short-horizon reversal after a big up-day offsets weak momentum, so we center slightly below spot (median $59.0) with a monthly sigma of 0.23 (86% realized vol / 3.5 = 0.25, trimmed for vol mean reversion), close to a symmetric spread.

downside.story: P10: memory-price shock deepens (PC units ~-14% in 2027, TrendForce's high-single-digit notebook case plus desktop weakness), Arm/AMD take more server share than TrendForce expects while Intel 3/18A supply stays short, foundry losses stall near 2026 levels and capex keeps FCF negative into 2028; the market re-rates Intel to ~30x, between the peer median and today's own multiple. base.story: PC units fall ~8% in 2027 (memory squeeze) and recover in 2028; server CPU units +40% in 2027 (TrendForce) with Intel losing unit share to ~40% but gaining ASP, so DCAI reaches ~34B in 2027 and ~41B in 2028; foundry losses narrow to -6.4B and -4.3B; FCF stays negative in 2027 on ~26B capex. upside.story: P90: PC correction ends by Q1 2027, server CPU demand beats TrendForce's +40% and Intel's supply ramps (Intel 3 yields, Israel fab back), named 14A/18A-P foundry customers cut losses faster; the market pays ~48x NTM EPS for a recovering foundry story, as it did in Sep 2026.

reasoning: Base-rates lane. Setup: INTC closed $59.66 after a round trip from $142.35 (June) and ~$120 (early Oct): the Q4 guide on Oct 29 ($15-16B, GM 38%) and the CFO's 2027 PC TAM -10% plan triggered a ~28% one-day fall [src 21,1,2]; NVIDIA turmoil and a securities suit followed [src 22,24]. Base rates (own computation on 38 surviving US semis/tech large caps [src 29]): after a >=50% fall from the 12-month high within 6 months of the peak, with the trailing year still positive (n=40, mostly 2000-01), 12-month returns had median +23% (ex-1990s n=29: +13%), P10 -32% (ex-1990s -48%), P90 +450% (ex-1990s +220%), and 1 in 3 were lower a year later; INTC's own Dec-2000 case returned +3%. Survivorship bias inflates the upside, so I center below the raw medians. Driver build: PC units -12%/-8%/+5% (Intel CFO, TrendForce notebook, IDC [src 2,18,19]); server CPU units +31%/+40%/+20% (TrendForce, AMD TAM [src 17,20]) with Intel's unit share falling from ~53% to ~40% but ASP/mix +20%; foundry+other losses -8.0B/-6.4B/-4.3B. FY2027 EPS ~$1.33 sits at consensus $1.31 (+1.5%) [src 11]; FY2028 ~$1.94. Guidance: Intel beat 4 of 6 revenue guides (median +7%) and 5 of 6 GM guides, but the 2026 beats came with a PC channel build that is now unwinding; Q4 built per segment at $15.45B (inside). Valuation: P/E 40.5x (k=0.8 off a 23.3x peer median) on NTM EPS ~$1.88 gives $77; P10 $32 and P90 $140 from driver and multiple moves sized to the base-rate tails and 86% realized vol. Macro odds (Polymarket): US recession by end-2027 31.5% (thin, $27k) [src 25], AI bubble burst by mid-2027 28% [src 26], Taiwan invasion by mid-2027 4.7% [src 27]: these shape the left tail rather than the base. Research limits: WebFetch budget ran out mid-research; later pages were read with curl (Intel 2025 releases, TrendForce) and the SEC companyfacts API.

drivers.label: Intel DCAI revenue per industry server-CPU index unit ($M)
drivers.derivation: 2026: DCAI Q1 5,100 + Q2 6,300 + Q3 7,318 [src 6,5,1] + Q4 8,300 (Q3 x 1.134, slightly under the CFO's mid-teens sequential view [src 2] given the ~$300M Israel-fab hit) = 27,018 / 1.31 = 20,624. 2027: x (40/53) for share x 1.20 for ASP/mix = 18,679: Intel's unit share ~53% in 2026 (100 - Arm >20% - AMD ~27%) falls to ~40% in 2027 (Arm ~30%, AMD up further) per TrendForce [src 17]; ASP/mix +20% from higher-core-count Xeon 6 and a supply-short market. 2028: share 40% -> 38% and ASP +5% = 18,632. Gives DCAI 34.3B in 2027 vs the Q4 2026 exit annualised at 33.2B. Alternative: hold 2026 share (capture 24,749, +32% DCAI) or a deeper share loss to 35% (16,344).
drivers.why: Intel's supply-limited share of a fast-growing market is the key debate

drivers.label: Intel Foundry + All other operating income ($M)

guidance_check.why: Intel beat its point gross-margin guide in 5 of 6 quarters (median +6%), but the Q4 drivers (underloading, supply incident) are known and quantified, so we put only +0.5pt over the guide.

guidance_check.guide_basis: CFO statement: 'line of sight to long-term double-digit revenue growth'

track_record.note: No earlier long-term revenue target of this form to score; Intel's 2021-2024 IDM 2.0 targets (foundry breakeven, margin goals) were repeatedly pushed out under prior management.

guidance_check.why: FY2027 sits below double digits because the PC correction offsets DCAI growth; FY2028 reaches +13% on our server CPU path. We do not adopt the target as a path.

downside.story: P10: memory-price shock deepens (PC units ~-14% in 2027, TrendForce's high-single-digit notebook case plus desktop weakness), Arm/AMD take more server share than TrendForce expects while Intel 3/18A supply stays short, foundry losses stall near 2026 levels and capex keeps FCF negative into 2028; the market re-rates Intel to ~30x, between the peer median and today's own multiple. Base-rate check: after a >=50% round trip, 12-month P10 was -32% (all) to -48% (ex-1990s) [own computation].

upside.story: P90: PC correction ends by Q1 2027, server CPU demand beats TrendForce's +40% and Intel's supply ramps (Intel 3 yields, Israel fab back), named 14A/18A-P foundry customers cut losses faster; the market pays ~48x NTM EPS for a recovering foundry story, as it did in Sep 2026.

model_inputs.structure_note: Annual driver-led set (5 drivers: PC units, Intel client price/share, server CPU units, Intel DCAI capture, foundry+other EBIT) mapped into CCPG, DCAI and a plain 'Foundry and other net' segment (driven share 93% of FY2025 revenue). Value is carried by one P/E leg on the build's own GAAP EPS at the horizon (NTM ~ 90% FY2028); FCF is negative in FY2027, so no FCF-yield leg; no DCF (not a neocloud). SOTP (products vs foundry) not used: no credible listed foundry peer without TSMC's structural differences.
model_inputs.gap_note: Annual rather than quarterly set (time-boxed rerun); FY2026 Q4 is the only forecast quarter of FY2026. Financing: another equity raise in 12 months judged <20% (54B cash and investments vs ~6B FY2027 burn per our build; CFO committed to deleveraging) so not in financing_events. Escrowed DoC shares' future mark-to-market is non-operating and excluded. NCI earnings (~0.8B/yr run-rate, Q3 200M) are not deducted in the P/E leg's EPS; minorities are deducted only at book on EV legs, so the target is ~$0.14/share x 40x (~$5) generous on that count. k = 0.8 default kept though INTC's own multiple sits on depressed EPS (k 0.6 = -11%): flag for Kilian.
